servicesPage.heading: We build digital experiences that move your business forward.
servicesPage.body: From mobile applications to websites and web applications, Venkoi helps turn ideas into useful digital experiences — from early definition and design through development and testing.
servicesPage.mobileBody: We design and build mobile applications for iOS and Android, from customer-facing experiences to internal tools — intuitive, useful, and ready to grow.
servicesPage.mobileTheme1Desc: Designed specifically for your customers on mobile platforms.
servicesPage.mobileTheme2Desc: Operational tools built for team and business workflows.
servicesPage.mobileTheme3Desc: Solutions built to operate effectively in real-world environments.
servicesPage.webBody: You don't need to know whether you need a website or a web application. Tell us what you want to accomplish, and we'll help shape and build the right web experience.
servicesPage.webSupporting: From straightforward websites to more interactive web experiences, the solution should fit the idea — not the other way around.

howWeWork.heading: From idea to a tested, working product.
howWeWork.stage1Desc: Start with an idea, goal, or problem. We help clarify what should be built, who it is for, and what matters most.
howWeWork.stage2Desc: We shape the structure, flows, and interface so the experience is clear before and throughout development.
howWeWork.stage3Desc: We build the mobile or web experience using the technical approach that best fits the project.
howWeWork.stage4Desc: We test core functionality, important user flows, responsiveness, and the overall experience so issues are found before they reach users.
howWeWork.testingPrinciple: Testing isn't an afterthought. It's part of how we build.

hero.heading:
Know what you have.
Know where it went.
Know what it cost.
hero.body: Zaiko helps restaurants understand and manage their inventory, purchases, costs, and product activity from one clear workspace.

intro.heading: A clearer view of your restaurant inventory.
intro.body: Inventory shouldn't require jumping between spreadsheets, receipts, disconnected systems, and guesswork. Zaiko brings the core inventory picture together so your team can understand what is happening and make better-informed decisions.

inventory.heading: Know what you have and where it is.
inventory.body: Zaiko gives your restaurant a clearer way to understand the inventory you have on hand and keep it organized around the way your operation actually works.

purchases.heading: Keep purchasing and receiving organized.
purchases.body: Bring purchasing activity into the same inventory picture so incoming products and the costs connected to them are easier to follow.

activity.heading: See how inventory moves through your operation.
activity.body: Zaiko brings inventory activity into a clear history so it's easier to understand what changed and follow the movement of products over time.

costs.heading: Understand what your inventory is really costing.
costs.body: Keep inventory and purchasing costs easier to see so changes in product costs don't disappear inside spreadsheets and disconnected records.

workflow.heading: One inventory story instead of disconnected pieces.
workflow.body: Zaiko is designed to make the different parts of inventory easier to understand together — what came in, what you have, what changed, and what it cost.

earlyAccess.heading: Try Zaiko free for 3 months.
earlyAccess.body: Join our early access program and use Zaiko free for 3 months while we continue refining the product with restaurant operators.

finalCta.heading: Ready for a clearer view of your inventory?
finalCta.body: Start with Early Access or request a demo tailored to your restaurant's operation.
